text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Amsterdam Stock Exchange to set up new 'parallel' market for young, fast-growing companies. (p 1)
- Boxtel-based meat processing company Dumeco to open up share capital to private investors. (p 13)
- Property fund Rodamco buys French rival CEGEP fo 768 million guilders.
- U.S. Stevedore Ceres, which is to acquire CTA, has agreed conditions with Amsterdam port over site rental.
- Schiphol's growth picks up, with 12.8 million passengers passing through the airport in the first half of the year.
- Shipping/container group Nedlloyd to merge container business with Britain's P&O. (p 1)
- For Ajax, even NEC is too strong an opponent as they lose 2-0 (p11)
- Defence minister Voorhoeve recognises limitations of inquest into Srebrenica affair. (p3)
- Rotterdamers celebrate opening of Erasmus bridge (p1)
- KLM uses internet to sell air tickets (p13)
- Around 50,000 students no longer qualify for free medical insurance (p3)
